steps.text: Puberty is when the body matures during adolescence. Some changes happen in everyone, and some are specific. Let's look.
Tap “Common Changes” to see the ones that happen in everyone.
Common changes include a growth spurt, more sweating, and new hair growth. Now tap “In Boys” and “In Girls” to see the specific changes for each.
All of these changes are natural, healthy, and part of growing up. They happen at different ages for different people — there's no single "right" time.
